newsitem.title: INDIA: India Shipping Corp plans to buy 44 ships.
newsitem.headline: India Shipping Corp plans to buy 44 ships.

text.p: State-run Shipping Corp of India plans to buy 44 vessels with a total deadweight tonnage of 1.95 million during the ninth five-year plan (1997-2002), the Surface Ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said in a statement the total cost of buying these vessels would be about 45 billion rupees ($1.26 billion).
It said the increase in capacity was necessary to meet India's increasing demand for crude oil imports and also due to a sharp rise in waterways trade.
The company currently has a fleet of 29 crude oil tankers with a DWT of 2.74 million tonnes. ($1 = 35.8 rupees) --New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 2034
